name: openhire
description: First-party job listings from 139 employers' own ATS, with real posting dates and a ghost_score. No résumé ever leaves your machine.
long_description:
OpenHire turns Claude into a private job-search radar for AI / Infra, autonomous-driving and embodied-AI roles. It reads employers' own public ATS APIs (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Beisen, Moka) — not job boards — so every listing carries the real posting date, days_open and a ghost_score that ages off the employer's timestamp, plus a direct apply link.

Privacy is structural: there is no résumé field in the protocol, matching runs on your machine, and the only user-originated value the server stores is an anonymous fingerprint. Ranking is a locked pure function of (match, freshness) — no sponsored slots.

First start downloads the ~25 MB public snapshot (jobs/companies only). Requires Python ≥ 3.11 available to uv.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Hard-filter the live index; results carry verified_at, datePosted, days_open, ghost_score and apply_channel.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Aggregate, anonymous trust signals for one employer (ghost_score_avg, active_jobs).

tools.name: watch_intent
tools.description: Register a standing job intent under an anonymous fingerprint.

tools.name: check_watches
tools.description: Pull matches that are new since the last check.

tools.name: authorize_application
tools.description: Record an authorized, employer-direct application and return the employer's own apply URL. Refuses résumés.
